name: demoreel
description: A polished demo video of your real web app, recorded by your coding agent: smooth cursor, automatic zoom, captions, MP4 and GIF. Zero dependencies, just Node and the Chrome you already have.

interface.shortDescription: Record a demo video of your real app
interface.longDescription: Codex writes a short storyboard of plain-language steps, then Demoreel drives your real web app in a headless browser and renders a polished demo video: smooth cursor, automatic zoom on each action, captions, a browser or phone frame and a designed background. It exports MP4 and GIF, plus a contact sheet Codex reads to check its own video. Everything runs on your machine with no dependencies beyond Node and a Chromium-based browser.

Record a GIF of the checkout flow for the README
